## Canonical model parameters (auto-loaded from the [Parameters Hub](../parameters_hub.html))

All numerical claims in this brief draw from a single CSV — [`amua_import_parameters_v3.csv`](../amua_import_parameters_v3.csv) — rendered in full at the [Parameters Hub](../parameters_hub.html). The headline values below are pulled from that file at render time; **do not edit the numbers in this brief — edit the CSV and re-render**.

```{r}
#| label: shared-params-pull
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

raw <- readr::read_csv("../amua_import_parameters_v3.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

pick <- function(name) {
  v <- raw |> dplyr::filter(Name == name) |> dplyr::pull(Expression)
  if (length(v) == 0) NA_character_ else v[1]
}

zar <- function(x) {
  n <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (is.na(n)) return(x)
  if (n >= 1e9) sprintf("R%.2f billion", n / 1e9)
  else if (n >= 1e6) sprintf("R%.2f million", n / 1e6)
  else sprintf("R%s", format(n, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE))
}

tibble::tribble(
  ~Parameter,                                         ~Value,
  "Annual NMC pesticide notifications",                pick("n_nmc_annual"),
  "Annual NHLS severe BChE inhibitions (live)",        pick("n_nhls_severe_annual"),
  "Annual PIH pesticide-related calls",                pick("n_pih_annual"),
  "True annual burden (sum, upper bound)",             pick("n_burden_true"),
  "Headline annual deaths",                            pick("n_deaths_headline"),
  "Blended headline morbidity cost per case",          zar(pick("c_morbidity_headline")),
  "Mortality cost per death (human-capital)",          zar(pick("c_mortality_human_capital")),
  "Headline annual economic burden",                   zar(pick("C_burden_total_headline")),
  "Response efficacy η (base case)",                   pick("eta_response_mid"),
  "Detection probability — status quo",                pick("d_status_quo"),
  "Detection probability — full package",              pick("d_full_package"),
  "Full Package narrow operating cost / yr",           zar(pick("c_full_package_narrow_operating")),
  "Full Package whole-system operating cost / yr",     zar(pick("c_full_package_wholesystem_operating"))
) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Headline parameters used in this brief",
             subtitle = "Pulled from amua_import_parameters_v3.csv at render time") |>
  opt_row_striping() |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = "small")
```

### Who bears the R2.34B annual burden?

```{r}
#| label: shared-params-stakeholder
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

total <- as.numeric(pick("C_burden_total_headline"))

stakeholder <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Stakeholder,                                                ~Name,
  "NDoH — public hospitals (UPFS ward + ICU + drugs)",         "share_doh_morbidity",
  "NHLS — laboratory (BChE, GC-MS, repeat clinical chemistry)","share_nhls_morbidity",
  "DALRRD — regulator (no burden-side share by construction)", "share_dalrrd_burden",
  "Individuals / households — out-of-pocket + lost wages",     "share_individual_oop_morbidity",
  "Households / wider society — lost lifetime earnings",       "share_household_mortality",
  "TOTAL",                                                     "share_total_check"
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    raw   = vapply(Name, function(n) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pick(n))), numeric(1)),
    Value = vapply(raw, zar, character(1)),
    Share = ifelse(is.na(raw) | total == 0,
                   "—",
                   scales::percent(raw / total, accuracy = 1))
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Stakeholder, Value, Share)

stakeholder |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Annual burden by stakeholder (headline scenario, ZAR 2025)",
             subtitle = "Each rand of the R2.34B falls on exactly one bearer") |>
  cols_align("right", c(Value, Share)) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = Stakeholder == "TOTAL")
  ) |>
  opt_row_striping() |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = "small")
```

**Reading the table.** ~96 % of the R2.34B is **mortality, borne by households and the wider economy** as lost lifetime earnings (1,500 deaths × R1.5M human-capital, undiscounted; sensitivity: R1.05M at 3 % discount). The directly-budgeted health-sector share is **R80M** (NDoH ~R70M hospital + NHLS ~R10M lab) — modest in absolute terms, but it is the only column that appears on a departmental budget line. DALRRD bears **R0** of the *burden* side by construction: their cost sits on the *intervention* side (enforcement, recalls, registration action).


For the full sourced parameter set (CFR by severity, UPFS tariffs, per-option costs, induced-demand components, DALY monetisation, NMB), see the **[Parameters Hub](../parameters_hub.html)**. For the v2 → v3 critical appraisal, see [`parameter_appraisal.qmd`](../parameter_appraisal.qmd).
